_about: SCHEMA GAP content: what the picked design shows and schemas/site-content.md v0.11 has no field for. Written by scripts/seed-from-dossier.mjs from copy/en.json and dossier.json; listed in notes.md "schema gaps". Edit there, not here.

typeLine._source: the hero line "Bed and breakfast | Midigama, Sri Lanka" (4f r1, critic d4: type + place on the first screen). businessType is an enum (beach_lodging) with no display wording; this is Google's category (dossier business.google_category, "Bed & breakfast")

houseCount._source: the glance line "7 rooms, all doubles | sleeps 14". rooms[] holds the two room types Booking.com sells, not the house's count; the copy says it in words ("All seven rooms are doubles, and between them they sleep fourteen.", Seven rooms ¶1); dossier room_types[3] (Airbnb, 7 bedrooms, 1 double bed each, sleeps 14)

host._source: the "A question first" answer's button, "Ask Ashly on Airbnb". The schema has no host / owner name for a lodging site (team[] is a brand module); the name is the copy's ("Your host is Ashly.", copyBlocks about "Ashly") and dossier business.owner

bookingRoles._source: "Who's coming?": which bookingLinks[] row answers which tile (Two of you → the Booking.com listing and the Airbnb room listing; A group → the whole house on Airbnb; A question first → Airbnb's messaging on the room listing, dossier contact.airbnb_messaging). bookingLinks[] rows have no audience field

_everyRoom: the "In every room" icon list (concepts.md §3): the objects the copy names in "Seven rooms" ¶2, shortened; the fifth item is amenities "Fan and mosquito net", read from content.json. The schema has no per-room feature list
